description: This file defines a React functional component called ProductDetailsPage that serves as a placeholder page for displaying detailed information about a product in a fashion retail front-end application. It uses React Router's useParams hook to extract a product id from the URL parameters and renders a static UI with sections for gallery and product info, including buttons for adding to cart and navigating to the cart.

methods.name: ProductDetailsPage()
methods.description: React functional component that renders a placeholder product details page, including product id from URL params, gallery and info sections, and action buttons.
